description: High Intensity Rainfall Design System (HIRDS) is a data repository run by NIWA (Earth Sciences New Zealand). HIRDS gives design rainfall depths and intensities for New Zealand for chosen durations and return periods, including climate-change adjustments, through a map tool and downloads. Coverage: New Zealand. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, viewer; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("HIRDS on DataHub | DataHub") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support stormwater and culvert design studies of New Zealand. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
